Stella Johnson is a beautiful widowed single mother who lives in the town of Harper Valley , Ohio . She sells cosmetics door - to - door for the fictitious AngelGlo Cosmetics
Her fourteen - year - old daughter , Dee , is a student at Harper Valley Junior High School
which is led by the pompous and snobbish Flora Simpson - Reilly

Amzie Strickland as Shirley Thompson , a member of the PTA board who tends to drink a lot of gin . Though she is allied with Flora and her friends , she is one of four PTA members ( Will , Skeeter and Holly Taylor are the others ) who are spared any retribution from Stella . She was seen as the most sympathetic of the board , as she tended to be more manipulated as opposed to being manipulative . It was never revealed whether or not she retained her seat on the PTA , but it is presumed that she became more sympathetic towards Stella as she was seen waving goodbye at Olive as she was being arrested
